The test image shows a mango leaf with small scattered brown spots/lesions across the surface. Plant part: leaf. All 4 classes can affect leaves.

Key visual features: multiple small brown irregular spots distributed across the leaf surface. No white powder (rules out Powdery_Mildew), no black sooty coating (rules out Sooty_Mould), no wilting/curling (rules out Die_Back). Points toward Anthracnose.

Now viewing one reference per class:

**Analysis:**

- **Test image**: Green mango leaf with multiple small, scattered brown spots/lesions across the surface. Some appear as small discrete necrotic spots.
- **Anthracnose ref**: More advanced necrosis, but matches the irregular brown spot pattern
- **Die_Back ref**: Fully dead, curled brown leaf - not matching
- **Sooty_Mould ref**: Black sooty patches, distinctly darker than the brown spots in test image
- **Powdery_Mildew ref**: White/grey powdery coating - not matching

The test image shows small scattered brown irregular spots on a green leaf - consistent with early/moderate Anthracnose (irregular oval/brown spots on leaves). No white powder, no black sooty coating, no wilting/curling.
